docs/held-out-gate.md -- the gate verdict lives on the in-process RunRecord only and is never persisted; the new held-out-gate park record IS that persisted verdict
constraints: Introduce the new park_kind values as ONE named, shared set: held-out-gate, protected-paths, push-failed, submit-error. Every new emit site uses a value from this set; pick stable kebab-case spellings and keep them identical across the worker, pr, and orchestrate sites so the fw status reader (built in a dependent task) can recognize all of them.

Each new record carries a non-empty detail: the offending protected path(s), the push/gh stderr, the swallowed exception text, or the held-out gate reason respectively -- so the operator can tell one strand from another.

Audit-witness only (D-2): do NOT change WHEN/WHETHER a land is suppressed. The protected-path refusal still refuses, the push failure still parks, the swallowed exception is still swallowed, the gate-blocked submit is still not called, and the run stays Status.DONE. The record's fold is the identity (advances version only).

submit() must still never raise into the orchestrate loop: the new recording call goes through the helper's own try/except (or equivalent) so a store error logs and returns rather than escaping (D-2).
The held-out-gate record attaches to outcome.lifecycle.run_id via the control store already in scope at the gate-block site; do not invent a new store handle.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT add any retry, respawn, re-drive, or auto-land behavior -- visibility only; re-driving is a later phase.
Do NOT change the run's terminal status, the gate's blocking decision, the protected-path predicate, or the standing-verify/divergent-base/uncommitted-work paths that already record.
Do NOT weaken, delete, or relax any assertion under packages/*/tests/; do NOT modify the existing _record_landing_park guarantee that it never raises.
Do NOT touch the orchestrator-events ledger or the fw status renderer here (separate tasks).
Do NOT make flywheel_core.events impure (no json/pathlib/io) -- the dataclass stays pure.
edge_cases: A held-out source that returns FAIL must produce a held-out-gate park AND no merge/PR -- a record with a landed branch must fail.
Both the merge strategy and the PR strategy protected-path refusals must each emit a record; recording one but not the other must fail (narrow-coverage cheat).
A forced _submit exception must be swallowed (submit returns None) AND leave a submit-error record; re-raising the exception OR emitting no record must both fail.
A returned-constant park_kind (always the same string regardless of cause) must fail: each site's record names its own cause.
